correctness.rationale: The backward two-orientation generator is explicitly derived for each constant-hazard piece. Since the 2x2 transfer matrix squares to the positive squared spatial decay rate times the identity, two exact interface relations yield the closed-form splitting probability for all positive widths/rates and any interior initial data. One-dimensional symmetric paired-run displacements ensure recurrent entrance visits and almost sure capture. The derivative of log(R_L/R_R) is strictly one-signed when B_L != B_R because the relevant hyperbolic-sine derivative has a strict sign; endpoint signs therefore prove exactly one crossing iff the two rate rankings oppose. The only identically equal case forces identical trap parameters. Independent matrix-exponential transfer implementation confirms 400 randomized inputs to max absolute error 1.62e-13, plus 300 derivative tests and 110 crossover checks. Verified limits, normalizations and strict positivity; simulations alone are not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The closest source treats finite traps only in the mirror-symmetric setting; separate sources treat two inequivalent sticky *walls* or a single confined reactive target. Their recorded statements do not imply a complete one-crossing criterion for two unequal penetrable finite capture regions. The present result distinguishes local hazards from integrated hazard strengths and proves a strict speed-monotonic impedance ratio. The existence of this speed reversal is an explicit mathematical result not found in the inspected primary material; generic telegraph transfer and absorption/splitting methods are prior knowledge. Search noncoverage is only qualified evidence, not proof of uniqueness.

value.rationale: The physical competition between distinct reactive environments is not resolved by survival-time formulas for symmetric zones or two sticky wall models. This result determines a complete, natural parameter phase partition for a nontrivial observables: direction of eventual immobilization. Its key counterintuitive mechanism is rank reversal between local capture rates and spatially integrated capture strengths. The exact all-parameter iff criterion and a strictly unique crossover are useful for sorting, adhesion, and active-search design; the result is not a one-off computed constant, normalization identity or textbook sign check.
